texte:
Tunis, get ready for a night of good music & great vibes! 🔥

Electronic beats, experimental sounds & Mediterranean influences come together for a special night by Goethe-Institut Tunis & Habibi Downtown.

🎧 THE LINE-UP

21:00 — Mariem KMS
Eclectic electronic beats, bass music & underground sounds from the Arab world and North Africa.

22:30 — Taroug (Live) | Germany → Tunis
A German-Tunisian artist blending electronic music, live improvisation & Mediterranean influences into an immersive sonic journey.

23:30 — Yasmine Sun
Hypnotic grooves, organic sounds & vibrant electronic rhythms to keep the dancefloor alive.

✨ Three artists. One dancefloor. A night of music, energy & connection.

📍 Habibi Downtown, Tunis
Presented by Goethe-Institut Tunis

texte:
NOVEMBER IS LOOKING GOOD FROM UP HERE. 💙✨

Another week, another reason to come upstairs.

Radio sessions, jazz moods, live music and electronic grooves a little something for every kind of night.

And while JAOU takes over the city, Habibi Downtown keeps the nights going. We’re happy to be part of the festival, hosting the official JAOU afters and bringing everyone together, night after night.

Good music, good food, drinks, rooftop views and familiar faces ❤️
